metrics.tube_centerlines: Straight riser and outlet; a gentle lateral offset in the long fore-aft feed has axial socket entries

soda_route.flow: Cold-core soda outlet → straight rise → nested west/aft elbows → feed beside V-K → meter → straight aft run → nested bulkhead stems → soda bulkhead

upstream_handoff.scope: The soda riser follows the retained core port and extends 12 mm below the handoff plane

soda_route.scope: Measured exterior meter on edge, with square component axes and directly nested stem elbows. Socket engagements remain family-based estimates. Both water routes are drawn; the flexible pigtail and retention detail are separate.

hardware_scope: V-A stays low; V-B feeds Y-B through an aft-side stair over the PCB. The valve inlet uses a directly seated stem elbow. The edge-on meter between the pump and CO2 path connects to both the core soda outlet and rear bulkhead.
insertion_scope: Family-based layout estimates. Drain outlet stem retains 3.3058 mm exposure for the cradle; other stems seat shoulder-flush.
